put.description: Admin; JSON or multipart/form-data. Five non-logo settings fields required. Optional file field logo: one PNG/JPG/GIF/WebP, maximum 2 MiB (2097152 bytes), matching extension, MIME and header/signature checks (not a full image decoder); unsafe filenames rejected. Multipart lesson_duration digit text converted to number. logo_url accepts empty string, supported public HTTP(S) raster link, or the exact current server-owned canonical /uploads/branding/<32 lowercase hex>.(png|jpg|gif|webp) path; arbitrary local paths are rejected. Upload wins over validated logo_url. Do not persist a frontend display-origin URL as a canonical local logo value. logo_url is optional. Without a file, omitting logo_url retains the current validated logo; explicit empty string restores the default logo. With a file, omission is allowed and the uploaded file becomes the canonical logo.
